Protocols: TANE samples 600 tasks with 15 queries per known class and 5 unknown classes of 15 queries; GEL uses the same query structure but states neither the number of test episodes nor what its intervals are; this work uses 600 fixed episodes per shot and 95\% CIs. tieredImageNet: images are fed in blue--green--red (BGR) channel order to both released checkpoints. \textsuperscript{\dag}Released TANE checkpoint (stored epoch consistent with selection on the test split).\par
